description: The Turtle Beach VelocityOne Flightdeck is a premium HOTAS simulation system for Windows 10 & 11 PCs, engineered to deliver enhanced immersion for sim enthusiasts who demand the best. Inspired by state-of-the-art jet fighters and advanced spacecraft to provide a ground-breaking HOTAS experience, designed for all major flight simulation titles with the future in mind. Comprehensive controls including 15 axes and 139 programmable functions keep you immersed in the action, with your hands on the controls. Flight Touch Display, and an OLED Head Up Display deliver unprecedented levels of performance optimization, and product customization. Plus, the Flight Hangar app for desktop provides even more in-depth customization, including RGB lighting zones.

Complete with exhaustive controls at your fingertips. Dual throttle levers with integrated locking latch allow for maximum flexibility whether you need single engine or multi-engine control. Ultra-smooth throttle control is enhanced with haptic detents, that are fully adjustable via the Flight Touch Display dashboard. The reverse of the throttle controls is equipped with rocker switches to jam enemy radar or GPS, as well as a scroll wheel, selector button and a 4-way remappable navigation pad. The thumb area, includes an 8-way HAT switch on the right side of the throttle, allowing for quick toggle between attack modes, a thumb wheel controlling zoom, analog POV button controlling the radar cursor movement plus a slider switch for air brake. Three remappable buttons are all fully customizable for controlling even more systems. Quickly extinguish engine fires with the FIRE button located on the upper right side of the throttle module or remap to weapons control. Just underneath the FIRE button, you’ll find three dials for easy autopilot adjustments, plus all three dials and button presses are remappable to your liking. Changing the aircraft’s flight configuration is easy using the flaps lever in the bottom left-hand corner of the throttle module, with two detents at each end of the lever to allow fully extended or retracted flaps.

The first fully programmable integrated simulation display provides customizable, touch screen buttons for dynamic, real-time sim alerts and settings adjustments. Customizing the Flight Touch Display with the Flight Hangar desktop app adds up to 39 extra buttons, which are configurable in color, label, and style for a fully immersive, customized experience. Plus, you can adjust settings and product performance to make Flightdeck perfectly suited to how you want to use it.

Loaded with controls and three non-contact axes featuring hall-effect sensors, the modular stick is built for high-fidelity pitch, roll & yaw maneuvers. Located at the top of the stick, the Head Up Display screen (HUD) provides critical in-flight information and allows you to adjust performance on-the-fly. A full-color screen provides extensive adjustments to the Chrono, touchpad, Pro-Aim, Rudder lock, trim wheel, haptic feedback, lighting and more. Look around with an analog POV thumbstick, and control quick-look with an 8-way HAT switch, plus an additional 8-way HAT switch gives you fine adjustment for sensor controls. Front and center, the FIRE button is easily accessible for releasing bombs, firing missiles, or gunning down your opponent. Plus, flip the orange touchpad lock and switch the functionality of the FIRE button between a standard physical button press, or to touchpad and mouse click functionality. Just below the FIRE button, is a trim wheel, which can be kept as analog trim adjustment or changed to button mode for digital trim. On the reverse of the stick, is a two-stage trigger for arming weapons before launch and an analog lever. Squeeze to gradually apply brakes, or fully compress to activate the button at the end of lever travel to disconnect autopilot while airborne. For maximum comfort, the stick is height adjustable to accommodate all hand sizes. On the base of the stick module are an ultra-realistic landing gear lever, accompanying gear indicator lights, a three-position rotary Parking Brake selector, five programmable push buttons and three remappable toggle switches with two functions per switch. Plus, the Flightdeck features a 3.5mm audio port, so you can connect any 3.5mm wired headset and take advantage of proven Turtle Beach audio enhancements for ultimate immersion in battle. PC Software Full Control Compatibility*: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 & Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, X-Plane 11 & 12, DCS World, Prepar3D, Star Citizen, War Thunder. Full functionality, control mapping required out of box.

description: The Lenovo Yoga Pen is the ultimate stylus for professionals, students, and creatives who need precision and performance in a sleek, portable design. This pen is fully compatible with Lenovo Yoga, ThinkPad, ThinkBook, and Chrome devices, supporting a range of protocols including WGP, MPP2.0, MPP2.6, USI2.0, AES2.0, and AES1.0. Whether you're jotting down notes, sketching, or navigating through your tablet, this pen ensures a seamless experience with reliable pairing and connection. Designed for convenience, the Lenovo Yoga Pen features a magnetic attachment that securely holds the pen to your device, preventing loss and making it easily accessible. The LED indicator allows you to quickly check the battery and charging status, while the USB-C charging ensures fast and efficient power for your stylus. No more wasting time with long charging cycles or dealing with disposable batteries. For extended use, the Lenovo Yoga Pen’s nib is replaceable, ensuring you get maximum longevity from your stylus. This makes it an ideal choice for long-term use, providing you with the flexibility to maintain the pen’s performance as the nib wears down. The pen also comes with side buttons that let you toggle between sleep and off modes, preserving battery life when the pen isn’t in use, so you can enjoy longer uninterrupted sessions of writing, drawing, or creating. Whether you're a digital artist, professional, or student, the Lenovo Yoga Pen offers a smooth, paper-like writing experience that feels just like writing with pen on paper.
